description: Closed assetRole vocabulary built from the slot kinds actually present in the clone (slot ids and pattern rules). Wired through the PageSpec schema, the component allowlist and the example. Roles with pinnedPolicy:true are compliance-critical: verify_all and the adversarial suite check the exact policy value, not just membership in generationPolicies.
sourcePolicyNote: The clone mimics a real company (watershed.com). Its real copy, photography, product screenshots, customer logos and brand marks are deliberately NOT in the clone and must never be generated or reproduced.

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: The generator may produce a new original asset (invented data, no third-party material).
generationPolicies.must-use-openly-licensed-photo-with-cred: Only an openly licensed (CC0) photograph from the credited pool, or a new CC0 photograph added together with a credit line. Never a photograph taken from the source brand.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: The generator must not generate, synthesise or imitate the asset. Reference only an existing openly licensed photograph from the credited pool; never a real or realistic named person, employee, customer or executive.
generationPolicies.invented-mark-only: Only an invented text or simple geometric mark. Never a real company logo, wordmark, brand mark or a lookalike of one.
generationPolicies.placeholder-only: Render the same-size neutral gradient placeholder. Do not generate or source an image for this role.
generationPolicies.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Never wire a real submission endpoint. Forms in the clone post nowhere and show a neutral placeholder notice.
generationPolicies.user-supplied-or-invented-mark: Only the deployer's own logo (supplied at deploy time) or an invented text or simple geometric mark. Never the source brand's wordmark or mark, the clone's Northwind wordmark, or a lookalike.
generationPolicies.reserved-domain-only: Only reserved documentation hosts: *.example, *.invalid, example.com, example.org, example.net. Never a real or source domain, endpoint, store link or social profile.
generationPolicies.original-copy-only: Write new copy for the generated brand. Never reproduce or lightly reword the source's or the clone's text; the source-copy shingle check rejects runs of five identical words.

sourceBrand.$comment: GENERATED by extraction/build_source_brand.py from the project's src/, routes and specs. Not human-reviewed. Do not hand-edit; re-run the script.
sourceBrand.reviewStatus: UNREVIEWED. Every pattern was derived by a script (heuristics named in each category's derivation) from literals found in the source project; no human has reviewed the set. It is exact-text and regex matching on NFKC-normalised text: a paraphrase, a translation or a spelling that survives normalisation passes, ordinary words inside the brand (the substring 'watershed') are blocked on purpose, and ambiguous English-word customer names are not matched in text.
sourceBrand.normalization: Before matching, every string is NFKC-normalised, zero-width and soft-hyphen characters are removed, curly quotes become straight quotes, dashes become hyphens and runs of whitespace collapse to one space. Patterns are matched with re.search (flags per pattern).
sourceBrand.scope: Matched against every human-readable string of a `mode: generated` PageSpec (route, headings, body, labels, items, alt text, hrefs). Structural vocabulary (template and section ids, variant names, assetRole, tone, motion ids) is exempt: it is the contract's own vocabulary.

derivation.brand: Brand tokens found in src/, routes and the specs: northwind, watershed, watershedclimate, watershedcom, watershedmarketplace, watersheds. 'watershed' is the real company, 'northwind' the clone's stand-in (src/content/seed.js maps the former to the latter).
derivation.program: Programme names of the source read from its routes (/climate-leads, /ai-fellowship). Warns only: both are plain phrases.
derivation.cta: Brand-verb labels plus every verb-led 2 to 5 word label found in a label/cta/button/primary field of src/ (generic labels such as 'Read more' excluded).
derivation.url: Every host named in CLONE_SPEC.md, PAGES_SPEC.md and ASSET_MANIFEST.md except the clone's own image-credit hosts, plus social profile handles.
derivation.customer: /customers/<slug> route slugs: single or two-word slugs, concatenated slugs split with the system word list, and non-dictionary tokens of sentence-style slugs. 3 single-word names that are English words are NOT matched in text (listed in ambiguousEnglishWordNames); they are still blocked as logos (asset role).
derivation.person: Names parsed from route slugs of profile, joins, Q&A and conversation pages.
derivation.rating: Star glyphs, numeric scores, the review platform g2.com and the analyst firms whose ranking slugs recur in the routes.
derivation.thirdParty: Competitors from /compare/<slug> routes and third-party services named in the specs: real companies a generated page may mention, so a match only warns.
